policy.conversion: Only tone marks removed from phonetic table values using upstream getPinyinWithoutTone; ü and ê retained, source/protected literal bytes never normalized.
special_rules: At start or immediately after a character absent from DICT1, unmatched 了 becomes liao.
Unmatched 々 repeats previous DICT1 first reading, otherwise tong.
一/不 tone sandhi changes no ordinary tone-free syllable.
policy.selection: Upstream max-probability nonoverlapping phrase selection. Character defaults retain all alternative readings in this artifact; default is first, not a contextual certainty claim.
